text:
maya: need a compact "enterprise deploy modes" quick-pack for field enablement by next Wed. must include: 1) one-page decision guide (security + SLA snapshot + recommended use cases), 2) short benchmark highlights (3 slides max), 3) webinar outline, 4) inbound routing playbook + HubSpot snippets. owners?

sam: i'll own the benchmarking + slide pack. i'll run three scenarios: conversational (3k context), embeddings throughput (100k vectors), and low-latency streaming (short answers). will include p50/p95, cost/1k-token, and a short methods note. ETA Tue EOD.

nina: i'll design the one-pager and write the hero blurb. draft headline idea: "Choose the right inference footprint: Hosted, Dedicated, or Private". will create two layout variants (use-case-first and SLA-first). need canonical SLA lines from product/security.

rahul: inbound routing & AE playbook I'll handle. proposed routing rules:
```
# HubSpot pseudo
if lead.tags contains "data_residency" or lead.request == "private_deploy":
    assign -> AE_enterprise_private
elif lead.usage_estimate > 1e6_tokens_month:
    assign -> Dedicated_sales_queue
elif lead.source == "trial" and trial_activity > threshold:
    assign -> SDR_followup
else:
    keep in self-serve nurture
```
I'll attach email subject templates and a sample HubSpot workflow.

olivia: i'll draft webinar flow + speakers and write the short promo copy for social & email. propose 40-minute session: 12m product demo, 12m benchmarks & methodology, 10m customer story (fintech or health), 5m live q&a, 1m CTA.

maya: permissions note: public one-pager should avoid deep technical runbooks for on-prem. gate any config docs behind gated asset. rahul, ensure the playbook references the gated pack.

sam: methodology blurb i'll include: "All tests run with consistent model family and tokenization; quantization parity noted; hardware: H100 for hosted/dedicated baselines, and representative x86 quantized on-prem for cost comparison. 10k samples per workload; warm cache conditions modeled."

nina: for the one-pager bullets, confirm these suggested lines: 
- Data controls: VPC peering, KMS integration, audit logs
- SLAs: hosted enterprise tier (99.9% uptime), dedicated (99.95%), private (customer-managed uptime)
- Deployment fit: Hosted = fastest to start, Dedicated = predictable throughput, Private = strict data residency & compliance
Are these ok to use as copy placeholders?

olivia: fine for marketing copy; product/legal must sign off on SLA numbers before external publish. we'll show them as "typical" values on the slide until signoff.

rahul: sample email subject lines: 
- "Which inference deployment is right for your team? Join our briefing"
- "Compare Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments — benchmarks inside"
I also have CTA copy and AE handoff checklist.

marketing-bot: calendar: webinar slot tentatively held 2025-04-15T16:00:00Z (session id wb-2045).

maya: timeline: owners deliver drafts by Tue EOD. Wed 09:00 PT internal review. finalize assets by Fri close for next-week AE play. gating: one-pager public PDF + gated appendix (benchmarks + on-prem configs).

sam: quick note on visuals: one benchmark slide per workload with simple bars for latency and cost. include a tiny methodology footnote.

nina: i'll share figma link in this thread when ready.

olivia: social promo short copy: "New quick-pack: decide between Hosted, Dedicated, or Private inference for your enterprise apps. Benchmarks, playbooks, and a live briefing. [signup link]". for linkedin we should add compliance and KMS mention.

maya: perfect. owners: sam (benchmarks + appendix), nina (one-pager + figma), rahul (routing + HubSpot snippets + gated flow), olivia (webinar + promo). reconvene Wed 09:00 PT. thanks team! :sparkles:
